$comment: Phase 0 asset manifest for Rancho Felipe. Every source file in 'Racho Felipe/' and 'C:\ranc layout' is accounted for below. Values marked "unconfirmed": true came from marketing graphics and need the owner's sign-off before they drive booking logic. Nothing here was invented.

business.name: Rancho Felipe
business.type: Private farm resort, booked exclusively one group at a time

address.formatted: Rancho Felipe, Maximiano Compound, Brgy. Dalig, Teresa, Rizal, Philippines

geo.$source: Resolved 2026-08-12 from the owner's Maps short link https://maps.app.goo.gl/7GEkxMbs8x4Ns5NQ7, which expands to a pin named 'Rancho Felife' in Teresa, Rizal.
geo.$note: This is a different short link from the one in the Facebook copy (YVVCyYR6YD7qirnc8). The owner supplied this one directly, so it wins.

business.accessNote: Final 300–500 m to the property is rough road. All vehicles, including vans, can pass.
business.$sourceConflict: The casita text file says 250–300 m of rough road; LOCATION.png says 300 m then 100 m, and its footer says the final 500 m. Owner to confirm one number.

contact.$updated: Owner instruction 2026-08-13: one number now reaches both units, replacing 0995-333-9526 (casita) and 0977-277-0716 / 0951-490-9094 (gazebo).
contact.$check: 092-646-2149 is ten digits. Philippine mobile numbers are normally eleven, written 09XX-XXX-XXXX. Used exactly as given — worth confirming a digit was not dropped.

links.$mapsNote: Owner-supplied 2026-08-12, replacing the YVVCyYR6YD7qirnc8 link that appears in the Facebook copy.
links.$note: Two separate Airbnb listings exist — one per unit. The brief assumed one. Neither URL has been opened or verified.

policy: 30% down payment secures the reservation date.
Down payment is non-refundable but the date is transferable.
No refund of down payment on back-out.
First down payment, first reservation. No pencil booking.
Send the payment receipt after paying.
payment.$note: The brief specifies a configurable 50% online reservation fee. Every asset says 30%. 30% is used as the default; make it editable in admin.

reservationFormFields.$source: Racho Felipe/New Text Document.txt — the owner's current manual booking form. The guest details form should collect exactly these.

checkInMethods.$source: Owner instruction, 2026-08-12. These override the printed times on the gazebo rate card (see $conflict).

fullStay.label: 22-hour stay
fullStay.$note: Owner called this '24hrs 2pm-12nn'. 14:00 to 12:00 the next day is 22 hours, which is exactly what every rate card prices as '22HRS OF STAY'. Modelled as 22h. Confirm the label guests should see.

custom.label: Custom hours
custom.$note: Owner allows custom in/out when the fixed windows do not fit the guest. Admin sets the times per booking; pricing falls back to the nearest package unless overridden.

checkInMethods.$conflict: The gazebo rate card prints Day tour 8AM–5PM and Night tour 8PM–5AM. The owner's instruction is 7AM–5PM and 8PM–6AM. The owner's instruction is treated as current; the rate card graphic is stale and should be reissued.
checkInMethods.$openQuestion: Turnover gap: night tour ends 06:00 and day tour starts 07:00 — one hour. The 22-hour stay ends 12:00 and a day tour would have started at 07:00. The calendar must know which combinations may share a date. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q6.

casita.name: The Private Casita
casita.shortDescription: Two A-frame cabins on a private pool deck, an hour from Metro Manila.

capacity.$note: Rate cards are banded 10-pax-below and 11–20 pax. No hard maximum is stated anywhere.

rooms.$note: The 10-pax rate includes 1 aircon room; the 11–20 pax rate includes 2.

rates.$source: PRICE AND AMENITIES/casita price and amnities 1.jpg + casita price and amenities 2.jpg + PRIVATE CASITA RESORT DETAILS.txt (all three agree)
rates.$note: 'Day & Night' on the poster = the 22-hour stay. No weekday/weekend/holiday split exists in any asset — the brief assumes one. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q3.

gazebo.name: The Private Gazebo
gazebo.shortDescription: Two air-conditioned gazebo rooms with their own pool, patio and farm view.

capacity.$note: Rate card bands are 10-pax-below and 16 pax. Nothing states what happens at 11–15 pax — see CONTENT-GAPS.md Q4.

rates.$source: PRICE AND AMENITIES/gazebo price and amenities.jpg
rates.$note: No extra-guest fee, no add-ons and no kids policy are printed for the gazebo. The casita's ₱300/head has NOT been assumed to carry over.

amenities: Large patio suitable for tent camping
Farm fruit and vegetables available to buy and cook

wholeProperty.$note: The brief asks whether a whole-property booking exists. No asset mentions one, and the two units have separate phone numbers and separate Airbnb listings — they may be run independently. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q1.

hero.$note: Both source videos are vertical 9:16 handheld walkthroughs. Neither works as a wide desktop hero without heavy cropping. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q7.

layout.$critical: C:\ranc layout contains exactly one file — 'ranch felipe layout.webp' — and it is NOT a site plan. It is a 1024x4090 screenshot of an unrelated resort website ('Stayverra', India & Costa Rica). No resort layout art exists on this machine. The interactive site map cannot be built from assets. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q2.
layout.$note: Every hotspot above has a real photo. Only the plan they sit on is missing.

reviews.text: Sulit po ang 2nights stay po sa uilitin po God Bless po
thank you din po sa pag accomodate, mababait po ang staff nio and super linis at bango din ng place..highly recommended for me

reviews.author: Ms. Nice
reviews.text: Very Recommended ang place if you want to feel the Province Peg. Sarap mag refresh ng mind since ung makikita mo lang mga puno puno. Super nag enjoy ung kids and adults, super babait at ackaso dn ng mga caretaker attentive sa mga needs. Thank you soo much po 2nd Time here and more vacation pa sa place na ito. Thank you

reviews.author: Jed
reviews.text: Ang ganda ng place, very probinsya ang vibe. Peaceful at malinis ang paligid at mga rooms, perfect talaga pang family. Mabait din ang mga care taker. Thank you po ulit sa pag accomodate! Sa uulitin po

reviews.author: Issa
reviews.text: Salamat po sa pag accommodate samin! Ang ganda po ng place. Surrounded ng nature kaya makakapag relax. Malakas ang wifi, malakas ang tubig, ang laki ng kusina, malinis ang rooms at CR, malinis ang pool at mabait ang care taker. Talagang perfect for all groups and occasions! Sa uulitin po.

reviews.author: Ziangg
reviews.text: Thank you worth it yung place ambait pa nung mga caretaker talagang inasikaso kami kahit late night Na kami nakarating. Sobrang nag enjoy kami sa place ang ganda at ang cool ng place nyo

$reviewsNote: 6 real reviews. No year is stated on any of them. 'review-thank-you-collage' is a marketing thank-you graphic, not a review, and is filed under marketing below.

marketing.$note: Composite graphics, not photography. Useful for social proof strips and the rates page, but they must not be used as gallery photos — they contain baked-in text that cannot be translated, resized cleanly, or given meaningful alt text.
marketing.$unusedReason: gazebo/13.jpg is a byte-level duplicate of the gazebo rate card already filed under rateCards. Converted for completeness, not placed.

promotions.label: Book today and get 10% discount
promotions.$note: No start date, end date, or conditions appear on the graphic. See CONTENT-GAPS.md Q5.

byCar: Search 'Rancho Felipe Teresa' on Google Maps or Waze.
Enter the rough road from the main highway and drive straight for 300 meters.
At the Aqua Joe water station, turn left and continue 100 meters to the entrance.
byCommute: From Crossing Term Terminal, ride a jeepney heading to Tanay.
Ride a local tricycle and tell the driver: 'Maximiano Compound, Rancho Felipe.'

video.$note: Hero loops are short, silent and muted-autoplay safe. Tours carry audio and are only fetched when a guest presses play. Source footage is handheld 60 fps walking, which compresses badly — 24 fps at 720 wide is the point where size stops hurting more than sharpness helps.
